name: EPIC 201681453
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 7.3 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,934 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.91 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,755 K at its surface.

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 3893107894972402048 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 600,000 of its distance per century
